statement:
(a b c : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) (aToL : SeqLim a L) (cToL : SeqLim c L) (aLeb : ∀ n, a n ≤ b n) (bLec : ∀ n, b n ≤ c n) :
  SeqLim b L
name: SqueezeThm
content:
If `a c : ℕ → ℝ`, with `a` and `c` both converging to `L`,
and `b` is another sequence, squeezed between `a` and `c`, then `b` also converges to `L`.
